web-guide-idea-90.audience: Beginners seeking instruction from a qualified yoga teacher.
web-guide-idea-90.offer: Offer a defined beginner session with clear guidance and adaptations. Teach within your qualification and avoid medical treatment claims.
web-guide-idea-90.steps.0: Explain the class level and invite relevant suitability questions.
web-guide-idea-90.steps.1: Lead a gentle sequence with options and rest.
web-guide-idea-90.steps.2: Close with a calm recap and guidance for independent practice.
web-guide-idea-90.equipment: A phone positioned to show the instructor’s body, safe floor space and any simple props specified.
web-guide-idea-90.returnReason: Develop a gradual beginner series, keeping each class’s focus clear.
web-guide-idea-90.promotion: State your actual qualification, class intensity and any preparation participants need.

web-guide-idea-90.metadataDescription: A qualified instructor leads a beginner class with clear guidance and suitable adaptations. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
